verdict.rationale: Streaming responses are a fair capability to expect from an AI gateway, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions streaming or token-by-token output. OpenAI Chat Completions compatibility and the unified multi-provider API are documented, but they do not establish that streaming is supported across providers, and inferring it would go beyond the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider
